taxonomy.sourceIdPolicy: Requirement registry contains normative Requirement, Decision, Acceptance Criterion and Release Gate IDs.
taxonomy.verificationIdPolicy: Golden vectors, boundary vectors and explicit test-matrix IDs are verification/Test IDs and are excluded from source requirement rows.

normalization.rangeHeadingRule: SEC-D01-SEC-D144, TA-D01-TA-D218, RT-D01-RT-D198 and PO-D01-PO-D285 are range notation only; concrete registry rows use canonical three-digit IDs.
normalization.fcIcRule: FC-* and IC-* are registered only when the concrete ID appears explicitly; missing members are not synthesized.
